subject: learning/standalone-review-tools
statement: The Go plan viewer and confirm-time feedback capture remain independently usable after the browser annotation runtime is removed. Plan rendering uses .pyxis/scratch and the pinned Mermaid browser bundle. The feedback command, resolver shim, and conversation adapter write confirmed review comments under the stable conversation source identity, while the historical doc-review ledger entry keeps its recorded source; Codex transcript analysis does not depend on the removed skill or scripts.
intent: Preserve independent diagram rendering, feedback records, and transcript measurements while removing the browser runtime and its prompts.
rationale: Mermaid has a live Go renderer consumer, and the generic feedback writer has a standalone CLI; neither is an exclusive dependency of the retired annotation UI.
fit_criterion: Plan-renderer tests verify the independent diagram bundle, feedback-capture tests preserve ledger semantics, and Codex adapter tests use current independent skill examples.

provenance.note: successor after #1224 renamed the feedback adapter to conversation
